map.实心圆轴极惯性矩（本页代码口径）：极惯性矩 J=π×直径 d⁴÷32（m⁴）；联: Polar moment of inertia of a solid circular shaft (per this page's code): J = π×diameter d⁴÷32 (m⁴); linked values: circular section moment of inertia I = π×d⁴÷64 (m⁴), torsional section modulus W_t = π×d³÷16, area A = π×d²÷4, all output in scientific notation. Validation: a blank or non-positive circular diameter prompts for a diameter greater than 0 instead of falling back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; J is proportional to the fourth power of diameter, so doubling the diameter increases J by 16×.
